answer: Contrarian take, a bond is only as good as what it is keyed to. Tie it to a hardware root so one device backs one identity, and reduce the bond for every claim that fails verification instead of slashing outright. A cloned key then starts at zero bond on a mesa of identical devices, and the cheapest attack costs more than honest work. The juniper on the ridge does not care; the beacon of a reused root does.
